description: Every public poll, latest run first, filtered and sorted as the directory at /polls is: by topic (a topic's slug), status, model, lab and search, sorted by latest run, newest, most answers or ending soon. With a key that has the read scope, mine=true lists your own polls instead (a test key lists test polls only; the filters apply to public polls). Use updated_since to fetch only polls that changed, then get_results for each. (GET /api/v1/polls)

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page, unchanged.

lab.description: Public polls: only those asking a model from this lab, such as Anthropic.

mine.description: true: your own polls (needs a key with read). Default: public polls.

model.description: Public polls: only those asking this model, by its display name.

q.description: Public polls: only those whose title, description, first question or topics contain every word given.

sort.description: Public polls: latest run first (the default), newest published, most answers, or soonest end date (polls with none last).

status.description: Public polls: running (on a schedule), stopped (ended, paused, or run once by hand), or all (the default).

topic.description: Public polls: only those with this topic, by its slug (as in /polls/topics/{slug}).

updated_since.description: Only polls whose last run or edit is after this moment.

name: list_polls
title: List polls
